name: canva
description: Community connector for Canva's official MCP server: search, create, edit, comment on and export Canva designs.

display_description.zh: 通过 Canva 官方 MCP 服务连接你的 Canva 账号：搜索和管理设计、AI 生成海报/演示文稿/文档、编辑文字与图片、评论协作，并导出为 PDF、PNG、PPTX 等格式。首次连接会在浏览器中打开 Canva 授权页面。社区连接器，非 Canva 官方出品；需要本机可用的 Node.js（WorkSwarm 自带）。
display_description.en: Connect your Canva account through Canva's official MCP server: search and organise designs, generate posters, presentations and docs with AI, edit text and images, comment, and export to PDF, PNG, PPTX and more. The first connection opens Canva's sign-in page in your browser. Community connector, not made by Canva; requires Node.js (bundled with WorkSwarm).

zh: 用 Canva 做一张“周五团队午餐”的海报，做好后把链接发给我
在 Canva 里找到我最近的演示文稿，总结每一页的内容
把我那份产品介绍的 Canva 设计导出成 PDF
把这张海报改成适合小红书的竖版尺寸
en: Make a Canva poster for Friday's team lunch and send me the link
Find my most recent Canva presentation and summarise each slide
Export my product overview design from Canva as a PDF
Resize this poster into a portrait version for Instagram Stories
